title: Al-Aqsa Mosque — Al-Qibli prayer hall
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Al-Qibli prayer hall:seven open northern pointed porch arches,green panel doors/pointed fanlights,raised nave with lead-grey roofs and large ribbed silver dome/finial near the south end;limestone buttresses,pointed windows/oculi,low attached wings and sparse parapet crenels. Five existing shared graphs and four browser LODs. Exact whole/dome controls retained;heights nominal and detailed profiles/current finish/exact terrain joins estimated or unverified. Other compound monuments excluded.

nativeAxes.z: south-southeast toward silver dome and south retaining edge

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained way/280309331 /Q12192963 identifies the southern Al-Qibli main prayer hall,not the entire Al-Aqsa compound or the separate golden Dome of the Rock. Current standard PMTiles whole35184652398163 and dome part35184663933670 retain32 raw outline points/properties. Earlier exact-QID whole/multilingual tags/facts and current named POI retained. Anchor[35.235542683,31.776175889] and heading0.175752450172rad unchanged,no horizontal rescale. Native+X east-northeast toward the east side wall,+Z south-southeast toward the silver dome/southern retaining edge,−Z north-northwest toward the seven-arch entrance and open forecourt. Three inspected pictures resolve signed facing,approximate3° uncertainty. Four compound minarets,separate pavilions,Dome of the Rock,other compound/town buildings and public forecourt remain host content.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Current whole height20m and dome part35m are nominal controls. Retained Wikidata37m height/55m width/80m length lack linked reference URLs and are consistency hints,not surveyed dimensions. The mapped whole includes attached lower west/east wings;the derived main hall is approximately55×81m. Estimated above-floor partitions:side walls14m/sloping lead roofs14.4–16.8m,raised central nave18.8m/eave and20m ridge;north seven-arch porch11.6m roof/12.4m parapet;dome drum20–23m and cap35m/finial37m. Lower attached wings8.5–10m are estimates;the whole20m tag does not survey each subsection. Open porch arches,door/window/oculus/portal/buttress/cornice/crenel/roof-rib details are picture-led approximations. Precise profiles,construction and current finish unverified.
